name: app-shater-three-roles-handshake-diagram-with-tablet-dashboard
title: Shater three-role diagram: client and craftsman shaking hands with a control-panel tablet arcing above
whatItIs: A light page with 'فهم وبناء التجربة' (Understanding and Building the Experience), an intro line, and a triangular diagram: client (01) and craftsman (02) phones flank a tablet control panel (03), with two curved orange arrows connecting to a handshake photo between them.
whatItMeans: Warm and structural; the handshake makes an abstract three-role system feel like a real partnership the platform enables.
techniques: Arrange roles in a triangle around a connecting photo.
Use curved arrows to show relationships, not just hierarchy.
Number each role for easy reference later.

vocabulary.definition: A product serving two or more distinct user groups.
A diagram showing how entities connect, not just rank.
